author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: LILYGO has added the T-Echo Lite Kit to its product lineup, a compact LoRa development device based on the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 microcontroller and an SX1262 LoRa transceiver. title: LILYGO T-Echo Lite Kit pairs nRF52840 with LoRa and 1.22-inch e-paper display
